mapper.select: SELECT C.CART_ID,C.USER_ID,C.PRODUCT_ID,C.CART_QUANTITY,C.CART_DATE,U.USER_NAME,P.PRODUCT_NAME,P.PRODUCT_PRICE,P.PRODUCT_MALL_NAME,P.PRODUCT_ISTODAY,P.PRODUCT_DISCOUNTRATE,PI.PRODUCT_IMGURL FROM CART C JOIN USER_DETAIL U ON C.USER_ID=U.USER_ID JOIN PRODUCT P ON C.PRODUCT_ID=P.PRODUCT_ID JOIN PRODUCT_IMG PI ON P.PRODUCT_ID=PI.PRODUCT_ID AND PI.PRODUCT_IMG_TYPE = '메인' WHERE U.USER_ID= #{user_id}; ORDER BY C.CART_DATE DESC

SELECT C.CART_ID as cart_id, C.CART_QUANTITY as cart_quantity, U.USER_ID as user_id, U.USER_NAME as user_name, P.PRODUCT_ID as product_id, P.PRODUCT_NAME as product_name, P.PRODUCT_MALL_NAME as product_mall_name, P.PRODUCT_PRICE as product_price, P.PRODUCT_DISCOUNTRATE as product_discountrate, PI.PRODUCT_IMGURL as product_imgurl, PI.PRODUCT_IMG_TYPE as product_img_type FROM CART C JOIN USER_DETAIL U ON C.USER_ID = U.USER_ID JOIN PRODUCT P ON C.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_IMG PI ON P.PRODUCT_ID = PI.PRODUCT_ID AND PI.PRODUCT_IMG_TYPE = '메인' WHERE U.USER_ID = #{user_id} ORDER BY C.CART_DATE DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cart WHERE user_id = #{user_id} AND product_id = #{product_id}
